description.narrative: Financing gaps to MSMEs in countries to be covered under this program are wide, although MSMEs are a major source of job creation. According to the MSME Finance Gap Report, the MSME finance gap in the two countries of interest and its proportion to GDP stand as follows: DRC (US$9.3 billion, 26% of GDP), Burundi (US$0.49 billion, 16% of GDP). MSMEs also face overly burdensome collateral requirements, partly reflecting the underdeveloped regulatory environment for credit provisioning. By providing the affiliates with medium-long-term financing for on-lending, the Project is expected to increase access to finance for SMEs. The team will further assess how the BOA DRC and BCB may target specific underserved groups, such as WMSMEs. Contribution to Market Creation: Competitiveness: BOA DRC and BCB are serving MSMEs with innovative and differentiated products and services. By helping to support scaling up of these MSME-focused business models, IFC expects that there may be a stronger demonstration effect in the market. During appraisal, IFC will document their MSME growth strategies, assess their competitive advantages in MSME finance, and determine how the Project may serve as demonstration to other banks in the target countries.

The proposed project entails the provision of a 6-year Risk Sharing Facility (RSF or the Facility) in the amount of US$30 million to cover two Bank of Africa (BOA) subsidiaries in IDA and FCS countries namely Bank of Africa Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Banque de Credit de Bujumbura; together the Beneficiaries for a target portfolio of SME loans in the amount of up to US$60 million equivalent. Under this project, IFC will be supporting the expansion of this regional banking groups SME lending across sub-Saharan Africa. This project is expected to be processed under the BOA RSF Program (the Program), a programmatic approach to risk sharing which aims to enhance and strengthen the capacity of BOA participating affiliates for risk taking and financing of SMEs in eligible countries in Africa.
